articles.author: Monica Alba, Megan Brand
articles.title: Trump says he will meet with Kim Jong Un this year - NBC News
articles.description: President Donald Trump confirmed to reporters that he plans to meet with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un this year, a highly unusual move for an American president, if not for Trump himself.
